```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

library(plotly)
```

```{r}
data(ny_noaa)
 
ny_noaa = ny_noaa |>
  filter(lubridate::year(date) == 2008) |>
  drop_na()
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Boxplot

```{r}
# distribution of monthly max temperature
noaa_df = ny_noaa |>
  mutate( 
    month = 
     factor(
      lubridate::month(date),
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = month.abb),
  tmax = as.numeric(tmax)/10,
  tmin = as.numeric(tmin)/10)

noaa_df |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, y = ~tmax, type = "box", color = ~month, colors = "viridis"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Daily Maximum Temperatures by Month, 2008",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Maximum temperature (°C)")
  )

```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatter

```{r}
# scatter plot of the relationship between snow and snwd
noaa_df |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~snow, y = ~snwd, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Snow vs. Snow Depth",
    xaxis = list(title = "Snow"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Snow depth")
  )
```

### Lineplot

```{r}
#max and min temperature across months
monthly_temp = noaa_df |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax),
    mean_tmin = mean(tmin),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_temp |>
  plot_ly(x = ~month) |>
  add_lines(y = ~mean_tmax,
            name = "mean of Maximum Temperature",
            color = "red") |>
  add_lines(y = ~mean_tmin,
            name = "mean of Minimum Temperature",
            color = "blue") |>
  layout(
    title = "Monthly Temperatures, 2008",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)")
  )
```
